# agents.md — PanelCraft

Agentic development conventions for this repository. **Humans:** this file is also for
you — it is the contributor handbook in condensed form. Full product spec:
[docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md). Format spec: [docs/FILE-FORMAT.md](docs/FILE-FORMAT.md).

## Project in one paragraph

Client-only web app for IcePanel-style architecture diagrams (IcePanel = inspiration
only, no links/affiliation in docs): WYSIWYG SVG canvas + always-visible code view,
native `.pcd` format (own grammar, mermaid-inspired), mermaid import/export converters,
flows/animation, multi-file workspace in browser storage only (nothing server-side),
ZIP import/export, GitHub Pages hostable, single Go binary (serve + validate/convert/
render CLI). License **GPL-3.0-only**.

## Ground rules (non-negotiable)

1. **License**: every new source file starts with the GPL-3.0 SPDX header
   (`// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only`). Deps must be GPL-compatible
   (MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD); new dependency ⇒ ADR first.
2. **Milestones are the contract** (SPEC §9). New ideas → backlog (SPEC §12), never
   silently expanded scope.
3. **Quality gates** (SPEC §8): Go `staticcheck` + `gocyclo ≤10/15`; TS `eslint`
   complexity ≤12, `tsc --noEmit` clean; **coverage ≥80% on core packages** (vitest
   thresholds enforce); corpus parity TS⇄Go is a CI gate.
4. **No unverified claims**: every "done" statement cites the command that proves it
   (test run, e2e pass, screenshot review). Mark unverified work as such.
5. **Storage stays browser-local.** Any change that adds a network call (beyond static
   asset load) violates SPEC FR-S1/N7 — reject in review. E2E no-network test is the
   enforcement.
6. **Docs stay human-readable.** agents.md and docs/ are written for people first;
   agent-optimized pointers secondary. No IcePanel URLs in docs (name-as-inspiration
   only).
7. **Architecture docs are written in PanelCraft itself** (SPEC §14): all architecture
   diagrams live as `.pcd` files under `docs/architecture/` — never ASCII/Mermaid art
   in Markdown. They are corpus seeds; keep them grammar-valid (FILE-FORMAT.md) and
   re-validate via `panelcraft validate docs/architecture` once M1 lands. Prose docs
   stay Markdown; normative content never lives in a picture alone.
8. **No external dependencies at runtime, no CDN — ever** (SPEC N7/N11): no external
   origins, no webfonts, no CDN scripts; everything inlined in the bundle / Go binary.
   Build works offline after one-time `npm ci` + `go mod download`. CI asset-origin
   scan (`scripts/check-selfcontained.sh`) + network-blocked e2e are the gates — a PR
   adding an external URL to a resource load must be rejected.

## Commands

```bash
# web
npm ci                       # install (lockfile committed)
npm run dev                  # vite dev server :5173
npm run check                # tsc + eslint (CI gate)
npm test                     # vitest run + coverage thresholds
npm run e2e                  # playwright (build first: npm run build)
npm run build                # static bundle → web/dist

# go
go build ./...               # bin: panelcraft (embeds web/dist — build web first)
go test ./...                # unit + corpus parity
go vet ./... && staticcheck ./...
gocyclo -over 15 cmd internal web && echo OK   # CI fails >15; target ≤10
                                               # (scoped: node_modules ships Go code)

# cli smoke
panelcraft validate testdata/corpus
panelcraft convert testdata/corpus/checkout.pcd -o /tmp/x.pcd
panelcraft serve --addr :8080 --open
```

## Definition of done (per task)

- [ ] Real check run and pasted as evidence (not "should pass")
- [ ] Coverage gate green for touched packages
- [ ] Complexity gates green (no new `// rationale:` exceptions without ADR)
- [ ] E2E scenario green if UI-touching; screenshots captured
- [ ] **Vision review pass if UI-touching**: screenshots reviewed against
      docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md checklist; defects filed or fixed (SPEC §8.4)
- [ ] Docs updated (SPEC/FILE-FORMAT/ARCHITECTURE/CHANGELOG as applicable)
- [ ] GPL headers present on new files

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
#
# verify.sh — CI-equivalent local gate runner (agents.md / SPEC §8).
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/verify.sh <milestone> [stage...]   run all stages, or named subset
#   bash scripts/verify.sh <milestone> --list       list stages
#
# Milestones:
#   m0  scaffolding gate: web check+test+build, go vet/staticcheck/gocyclo/test,
#       asset-origin scan, e2e no-network smoke.
# Later milestones extend STAGES below (docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

MILESTONE="${1:-m0}"
shift || true

log()  { printf '\n\033[1;36m== %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
run() { printf '\033[1;33m$ %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; "$@"; }

# ---- m0 stages --------------------------------------------------------------
web_check()   { run npm run check; }
web_test()    { run npm test; }
web_build()   { run npm run build; }
go_vet()      { run go vet ./...; }
go_static()   { run staticcheck ./...; }
go_cyclo() {
  log 'gocyclo -over 15 (CI fails >15; target ≤10)'
  # Scoped to repo-owned dirs: gocyclo has no exclude list and third-party
  # code under node_modules/** must not pollute the gate (M0 decision, M0.md).
  out="$(gocyclo -over 15 cmd internal web || true)"
  if [[ -n "$out" ]]; then
    echo "$out"
    echo "gocyclo: functions above 15 found — FAIL" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "gocyclo: OK (no functions above 15)"
}
go_test()     { run go test ./...; }
selfcontained() { run bash scripts/check-selfcontained.sh web/dist; }
e2e_smoke()   { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m1 stages (M1-WP8 parity gates + WP9 docs validation) ------------------
# corpus_ir: TS⇄Go serializer byte-parity on the shared IR fixture.
corpus_ir()   { run go test ./internal/ir/...; }
# corpus_ts: TS parse/convert output matches committed goldens (all corpus files).
corpus_ts()   { run npm run corpus:check; }
# corpus_go: Go parse/convert output matches the same goldens ⇒ TS⇄Go parity.
corpus_go()   { run go test ./internal/corpus/...; }
# validate_docs: dogfooding gate — PanelCraft's own architecture validates (WP9).
validate_docs() {
  run go run ./cmd/panelcraft validate docs/architecture
}

# ---- m2 stages (canvas MVP; reuses m1 corpus gates) ---------------------------
# perf_smoke: render-perf sanity — 300-object synthetic scene renders+re-patches
# under budget (N1 evidence for M2.md; full pan/drag baseline via e2e/PW traces).
perf_smoke() {
  run npx vitest run web/src/engine/render/perf.test.ts
}
# e2e now includes S1 (canvas create-flow) next to the S7 no-network smoke.
e2e_m2() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m3 stages (workspace & storage; reuses m1 corpus gates) -----------------
# workspace_unit: focused run of the workspace suite (fs/tabs/store/zip/io).
workspace_unit() { run npx vitest run web/src/workspace/; }
# e2e now includes S4 (workspace zip → clear → import; FR-S2/S3 paths).
e2e_m3() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m4 stages (code view & mermaid export; reuses m1 corpus gates) ----------
# sync_machine: focused run of the code view suite — sync state machine
# transition tests (M4-WP2, test-first), CodeMirror adapter, diagnostics map.
sync_machine() { run npx vitest run web/src/ui/codeview/; }
# exporter_goldens: mermaid export goldens per corpus file + re-import
# property test (M4-WP5, FILE-FORMAT §9 / FR-M4).
exporter_goldens() { run npx vitest run web/src/engine/format/mermaidExport.test.ts; }
# e2e now includes S2 (mermaid paste → canvas → edit → code updates; M4-WP6).
e2e_m4() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m5 stages (flows & animation; reuses m1 corpus gates) -------------------
# flows_anim: focused run of the playback suite — step machine + plan builder
# (M5-WP1) and anim engine with Clock/AnimPlayer ports (M5-WP2/3) — all
# deterministic (fake clock, injected player; no real timers in CI).
flows_anim() { run npx vitest run web/src/engine/flows/ web/src/engine/anim/; }
# e2e now includes S3 (play mode over a 6-step flow; M5-WP8).
e2e_m5() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

case "$MILESTONE" in
  m0)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test selfcontained e2e_smoke)
    ;;
  m1)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_smoke)
    ;;
  m2)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m2)
    ;;
  m3)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke workspace_unit web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m3)
    ;;
  m4)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke workspace_unit sync_machine exporter_goldens web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m4)
    ;;
  m5)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke workspace_unit sync_machine exporter_goldens flows_anim web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m5)
    ;;
  *)
    echo "verify.sh: unknown milestone '$MILESTONE' (known: m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5)" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--list" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "${STAGES[@]}"
  exit 0
fi

if (( $# > 0 )); then
  requested=("$@")
  for r in "${requested[@]}"; do
    known=false
    for s in "${STAGES[@]}"; do [[ "$r" == "$s" ]] && known=true; done
    if ! $known; then
      echo "verify.sh: stage '$r' not in $MILESTONE (run with --list)" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
  done
  STAGES=("${requested[@]}")
fi

log "verify.sh — milestone $MILESTONE — ${#STAGES[@]} stage(s)"
failed=()
for stage in "${STAGES[@]}"; do
  log "stage: $stage"
  if ! "$stage"; then
    failed+=("$stage")
    echo "verify.sh: stage '$stage' FAILED" >&2
  fi
done

log "verify.sh — summary"
if (( ${#failed[@]} > 0 )); then
  printf 'FAILED stages: %s\n' "${failed[*]}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "ALL STAGES GREEN — $MILESTONE gate passed"

## Icon license note (M5-WP6, ADR-0005)

The 8 inline SVG glyphs (cloud, database, gear, lock, mail, user, chart, code)
are **original in-repo works** drawn for PanelCraft — not copied from any
icon collection — so no third-party license obligation applies. Every
`web/assets/icons/*.svg` and every M5 source file carries
`SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only`. Only the path data is embedded
(`icons.ts`), rendered as inline `<path>` elements — no icon fonts, no
external requests. `icons.test.ts` asserts module/assets lockstep so the
inline copies cannot drift from the reviewed sources.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
#
# verify.sh — CI-equivalent local gate runner (agents.md / SPEC §8).
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/verify.sh <milestone> [stage...]   run all stages, or named subset
#   bash scripts/verify.sh <milestone> --list       list stages
#
# Milestones:
#   m0  scaffolding gate: web check+test+build, go vet/staticcheck/gocyclo/test,
#       asset-origin scan, e2e no-network smoke.
# Later milestones extend STAGES below (docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md).
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

MILESTONE="${1:-m0}"
shift || true

log()  { printf '\n\033[1;36m== %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
run() { printf '\033[1;33m$ %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; "$@"; }

# ---- m0 stages --------------------------------------------------------------
web_check()   { run npm run check; }
web_test()    { run npm test; }
web_build()   { run npm run build; }
go_vet()      { run go vet ./...; }
go_static()   { run staticcheck ./...; }
go_cyclo() {
  log 'gocyclo -over 15 (CI fails >15; target ≤10)'
  # Scoped to repo-owned dirs: gocyclo has no exclude list and third-party
  # code under node_modules/** must not pollute the gate (M0 decision, M0.md).
  out="$(gocyclo -over 15 cmd internal web || true)"
  if [[ -n "$out" ]]; then
    echo "$out"
    echo "gocyclo: functions above 15 found — FAIL" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "gocyclo: OK (no functions above 15)"
}
go_test()     { run go test ./...; }
selfcontained() { run bash scripts/check-selfcontained.sh web/dist; }
e2e_smoke()   { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m1 stages (M1-WP8 parity gates + WP9 docs validation) ------------------
# corpus_ir: TS⇄Go serializer byte-parity on the shared IR fixture.
corpus_ir()   { run go test ./internal/ir/...; }
# corpus_ts: TS parse/convert output matches committed goldens (all corpus files).
corpus_ts()   { run npm run corpus:check; }
# corpus_go: Go parse/convert output matches the same goldens ⇒ TS⇄Go parity.
corpus_go()   { run go test ./internal/corpus/...; }
# validate_docs: dogfooding gate — PanelCraft's own architecture validates (WP9).
validate_docs() {
  run go run ./cmd/panelcraft validate docs/architecture
}

# ---- m2 stages (canvas MVP; reuses m1 corpus gates) ---------------------------
# perf_smoke: render-perf sanity — 300-object synthetic scene renders+re-patches
# under budget (N1 evidence for M2.md; full pan/drag baseline via e2e/PW traces).
perf_smoke() {
  run npx vitest run web/src/engine/render/perf.test.ts
}
# e2e now includes S1 (canvas create-flow) next to the S7 no-network smoke.
e2e_m2() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m3 stages (workspace & storage; reuses m1 corpus gates) -----------------
# workspace_unit: focused run of the workspace suite (fs/tabs/store/zip/io).
workspace_unit() { run npx vitest run web/src/workspace/; }
# e2e now includes S4 (workspace zip → clear → import; FR-S2/S3 paths).
e2e_m3() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m4 stages (code view & mermaid export; reuses m1 corpus gates) ----------
# sync_machine: focused run of the code view suite — sync state machine
# transition tests (M4-WP2, test-first), CodeMirror adapter, diagnostics map.
sync_machine() { run npx vitest run web/src/ui/codeview/; }
# exporter_goldens: mermaid export goldens per corpus file + re-import
# property test (M4-WP5, FILE-FORMAT §9 / FR-M4).
exporter_goldens() { run npx vitest run web/src/engine/format/mermaidExport.test.ts; }
# e2e now includes S2 (mermaid paste → canvas → edit → code updates; M4-WP6).
e2e_m4() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

# ---- m5 stages (flows & animation; reuses m1 corpus gates) -------------------
# flows_anim: focused run of the playback suite — step machine + plan builder
# (M5-WP1) and anim engine with Clock/AnimPlayer ports (M5-WP2/3) — all
# deterministic (fake clock, injected player; no real timers in CI).
flows_anim() { run npx vitest run web/src/engine/flows/ web/src/engine/anim/; }
# e2e now includes S3 (play mode over a 6-step flow; M5-WP8).
e2e_m5() { run npm run e2e -- --project=chromium; }

case "$MILESTONE" in
  m0)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test selfcontained e2e_smoke)
    ;;
  m1)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_smoke)
    ;;
  m2)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m2)
    ;;
  m3)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke workspace_unit web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m3)
    ;;
  m4)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke workspace_unit sync_machine exporter_goldens web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m4)
    ;;
  m5)
    STAGES=(web_check web_test perf_smoke workspace_unit sync_machine exporter_goldens flows_anim web_build go_vet go_static go_cyclo go_test corpus_ir corpus_ts corpus_go validate_docs selfcontained e2e_m5)
    ;;
  *)
    echo "verify.sh: unknown milestone '$MILESTONE' (known: m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5)" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--list" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "${STAGES[@]}"
  exit 0
fi

if (( $# > 0 )); then
  requested=("$@")
  for r in "${requested[@]}"; do
    known=false
    for s in "${STAGES[@]}"; do [[ "$r" == "$s" ]] && known=true; done
    if ! $known; then
      echo "verify.sh: stage '$r' not in $MILESTONE (run with --list)" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
  done
  STAGES=("${requested[@]}")
fi

log "verify.sh — milestone $MILESTONE — ${#STAGES[@]} stage(s)"
failed=()
for stage in "${STAGES[@]}"; do
  log "stage: $stage"
  if ! "$stage"; then
    failed+=("$stage")
    echo "verify.sh: stage '$stage' FAILED" >&2
  fi
done

log "verify.sh — summary"
if (( ${#failed[@]} > 0 )); then
  printf 'FAILED stages: %s\n' "${failed[*]}"
  exit 1
fi
echo "ALL STAGES GREEN — $MILESTONE gate passed"

## 7. Views, positions, styles

### 7.1 Views

```
ViewStmt := "view" QuotedName ["as" Id] "{" ViewLine* "}"
ViewLine := "layout" ("auto" Dir | "saved")
          | "hide" "tag" Ident                       // repeatable
          | "hide" Id                                 // repeatable (element-level)
          | "position" Id "(" Number "," Number ")"   // saved coords, canvas units
          | "pin" Id                                  // excluded from auto-layout
```

* A file with no `view` gets the implicit default view (auto layout, everything visible).
* `layout saved` uses the `position` lines; nodes without position are auto-placed.
* Camera state (zoom/scroll) is **never persisted** in PDL (session concern).

### 7.2 Coordinates

Canvas units: 1 = 1 px at 100% zoom; origin top-left; y grows downward. Auto-layout
(dagre) outputs are written back only when the user explicitly commits layout ("apply
layout to file") — never silently.

### 7.3 Style overrides

```
style Id "{" StyleLine* "}"
StyleLine := fill ColorHex | stroke ColorHex | text ColorHex | icon Ident
           | shape (rect | round | cyl | queue | person | note)
```

* Colors: `#rgb` / `#rrggbb`. Theme supplies all defaults; `style` is override-only.
* Style overrides are also valid **inside** object/link blocks (`style { … }` line),
  canonical printer hoists them to top-level `style` statements? **No** — printer keeps
  styles where the user put them (stable diffing); hoisting is a formatter option, off
  by default.

function `text → PDL` (+ diagnostics), implemented identically in TS and Go (IR parity,

# M5 — Flows & animation (milestone log)

**Status:** in progress · **Gate:** `bash scripts/verify.sh m5` (18 stages)
**Scope:** IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §7 (M5-WP1..WP8) · SPEC §4.5 (FR-F1–F6)

| WP | Task | Status |
|---|---|---|

| M5-WP2 | Anim engine: WAAPI, token travel, dim sets, reduced-motion; Clock/AnimPlayer ports | **done** — `ports.ts` (Clock, AnimPlayer, waapiPlayer), `engine.ts` FlowAnimator 12 tests (dim swap, token+trail, flip, rings, badge, par, reduced-motion end states), `camera.test.ts` 7 (fit targets, glide, cancel, snap, restore) |

## Design decisions

- **Plan/executor split** (handover d): `engine/flows/plan.ts` is pure — parsed
  Doc + flow in, flat `Beat[]` out (index, kind, narration title, actors,
  resolved links, dim set, delayMs; par lanes as `Beat[][]` sub-lists). The
  executor (`engine/anim` + `ui/`) owns DOM and timers.
- **Dim semantics**: beats with no participants (intro/info/conclusion/goto/
  alt-chooser) dim NOTHING (FR-F2 overview / un-dim); focus beats dim every
  non-participating object+link id. Dim order = universe order (objects, then
  links) for deterministic assertions.
- **Canvas-side link ids**: `canvasLinkId(l, i) = l.id ?? from-to-i` exported
  from plan.ts — the same rule as workspace `docToState`, so beats address
  rendered `g.pc-link[data-id]` elements directly (single source of truth).
- **flip**: step-written direction reversed — travel = stepTo→stepFrom when
  `flip` (FILE-FORMAT §6 "plays the step reversed"); underlying link untouched.
- **goto**: cross-file target syntax is `goto "path.pcd#flowId"` (single
  quoted token — parser rejects bare dotted paths). Resolver injected
  (`FlowResolver`), so the executor supplies workspace lookup; `return here`
  semantics decided at executor level (planned: pop + replay the goto beat).
  Shipped: pop re-runs the popped beat's visuals without re-triggering its
  goto, then auto-advance resumes; `return flow` pushes a nested Frame.

**Status:** in progress · **Gate:** `bash scripts/verify.sh m6` (20 stages)
**Scope:** IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §8 (M6-WP1..WP8) · SPEC §4.6 (FR-V1–V4), §4.1 (FR-W6/W7)

| WP | Task | Status |
|---|---|---|
| M6-WP1 | Tags + filter bar + fade rendering (tag fade = render-layer opacity anim) | planned |
| M6-WP2 | Named views: store/switch, `hide tag`/`hide id`, saved positions, `pin`; default implicit view | planned |
| M6-WP3 | Auto-layout: dagre adapter behind LayoutEngine port; deterministic ordering (stable id sort); "apply layout to file" commit | planned |
| M6-WP4 | Dependencies view: incoming/outgoing highlight + list panel, click-through | planned |
| M6-WP5 | Quick search `Ctrl+P`: files/objects/flows fuzzy; jump-to | planned |
| M6-WP6 | Snapshots: named workspace snapshots in IDB, restore, prune | planned |
| M6-WP7 | Optional: flow→`sequenceDiagram` export (`.seq.mmd`) — droppable per slip protocol (PLAN §10) | optional |
| M6-WP8 | e2e additions (S5: tag filter, view switch, layout determinism smoke, search jump) + vision review round 3 | planned |

## Design decisions

- **Dagre dependency**: pre-approved — ADR-0004 (dependency policy: dagre MIT,
  "hand-rolling Sugiyama = high-risk algorithm code") and ADR-0005 §3 (license
  gate: dagre MIT listed as approved). Pinned via lockfile (`dagre@0.8.x`,
  `@types/dagre` dev-only).
- **LayoutEngine port** (`engine/layout/ports.ts`): pure contract — nodes
  (id + size + optional pinnedAt), edges (from/to), options (dir). Adapter
  (`dagre.ts`) is the only dagre importer; tests inject the adapter, UI
  composes it (ARCHITECTURE.md port rule).
- **Determinism**: adapter stable-sorts nodes by id and edges by
  `(from,to)` before feeding dagre, dedupes parallel edges (first wins), and
  post-normalizes to canvas units (top-left origin, y down, FILE-FORMAT
  §7.2). Same input arrays in any order → same output map (unit test gate).
- **Pins (FR-V4)**: dagre has no fixed-node support; pinned nodes participate
  in the graph (so topology/rank structure stays sound) and their saved
  positions are hard-overwritten after `run()`. Un-pinned neighbors lay out
  around the pinned rank structure; possible overlap with a pin is accepted
  for v1 and noted here.
- **Apply-to-file** (`engine/layout/apply.ts`): explicit-commit pure function
  `applyLayoutToView(doc, viewName, positions)` — writes `position` lines
  into the named view (replacing existing lines for the same ids, others
  kept), sorted by id for canonical printing. Unknown ids are filtered.
  Never called automatically — canvas camera/layout stays session-local
  until the user commits (FILE-FORMAT §7.2).
- **Implicit default view**: a doc with zero `views` gets a created view
  named "Default" on first explicit layout commit (the implicit default view
  has no syntax representation; the commit needs a concrete view statement).

## Evidence log

- 2025-11-07 — Kickoff: entry reads done (agents.md; PLAN §8 + §10 slip
  protocol; M5.md tail incl. vision round 2 polish notes; SPEC §4.6 FR-V*,
  §4.1 FR-W6/W7; FILE-FORMAT §7 views grammar; ADR-0004/0005). `verify.sh`
  extended with m6 stages (`layout_engine`, `views_search`, `snapshots`,
  `e2e_m6`) — 20 stages total; dagre + @types/dagre installed.

```
style Id "{" StyleLine* "}"

  styles where the user put them (stable diffing); hoisting is a formatter option, off
